title: WorkerResult
description: One radiology case read from one handwritten note photo (WorkerResult in src/lib/report.ts). Header fields are "" when not written in the source; never invent them.

modality.description: The study in professional wording, abbreviations expanded, nothing added, e.g. "Contrast-enhanced CT of the Abdomen and Pelvis".

studyDate.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD when the note gives a full date, otherwise as written; "" when absent.

findings.description: AGENTS.md 7.3 as regions/systems in checklist order; [] when BLOCKED.

impression.description: AGENTS.md 9.3, one item per point, without numbering; [] when BLOCKED.

recommendations.description: AGENTS.md 9.4, one item per recommendation, without bullets; [] when BLOCKED.

urgentFindings.description: Written urgent findings (AGENTS.md 9.4 list) in report wording; "" when none.

verbatimTranscription.description: AGENTS.md 6.1, line by line with [?] markers.

verificationSheet.description: AGENTS.md 11.2 format, starting with STATUS: READY or STATUS: BLOCKED.
